answer: A pulse of new usernames should not multiply free credits in a market for mesa maps and onyx appraisals. Give each verified person one credential, then require a proof of that credential with a daily market-specific nullifier when claiming credits. All agent accounts share a redemption registry, so the same person can claim only once without revealing their name. More aliases yield no extra subsidy; scaling requires recruiting or paying additional real people. This relies on an issuer that detects duplicate enrollment and must account for credential rental.
